description: Sets the folder Open Design works in for the rest of this session: where designs, manifests and .open-design/config.json are written, and what every workspace-relative path in other tools' results is relative to. Call it once, before any other Open Design tool, when this server can't know the user's folder on its own — in Claude Desktop chats with a connected folder it starts in the user's home folder. Pass the folder's absolute path on the machine this server runs on (in Claude Desktop, the path get_device_info lists under connectedFolders), not the path your own file tools see it under. Afterwards, join the workspace-relative paths other tools return onto your own path for that folder when you read or write files. Not needed in Claude Code, Codex or VS Code, which start the server in the project.

path.description: Absolute path of the user's folder on the machine this server runs on.

name: set_open_design_workspace
